+"""Tests for the optional notes field on BenchmarkRun."""
+
+from orgos.agile.benchmark import BenchmarkRun
+
+
+def test_notes_defaults_to_empty_list():
+    run = BenchmarkRun(
+        issue_id="TEST-1",
+        approach="solo",
+        model="gpt-4",
+        started_at="2025-01-01T00:00:00",
+        wall_seconds=10.0,
+        tokens_input=100,
+        tokens_output=50,
+        tokens_total=150,
+        cost_usd=0.01,
+        commit_produced=False,
+        commit_sha="",
+        files_changed=0,
+        loc_added=0,
+        loc_removed=0,
+        tests_run=0,
+        tests_passed=0,
+        tests_failed=0,
+        quality_ac=None,
+        quality_code=None,
+        quality_tests=None,
+        quality_summary="",
+        diff_text="",
+    )
+    assert run.notes == []
+
+
+def test_notes_serialises_through_to_json():
+    run = BenchmarkRun(
+        issue_id="TEST-2",
+        approach="team",
+        model="gpt-4",
+        started_at="2025-01-01T00:00:00",
+        wall_seconds=20.0,
+        tokens_input=200,
+        tokens_output=100,
+        tokens_total=300,
+        cost_usd=0.02,
+        commit_produced=True,
+        commit_sha="abc123",
+        files_changed=1,
+        loc_added=10,
+        loc_removed=0,
+        tests_run=2,
+        tests_passed=2,
+        tests_failed=0,
+        quality_ac=1,
+        quality_code=2,
+        quality_tests=3,
+        quality_summary="good",
+        diff_text="+hello",
+        notes=["first note", "second note"],
+    )
+    import json
+    data = json.loads(run.to_json())
+    assert data["notes"] == ["first note", "second note"]
